item.title: Spam calls
item.description:
Gos shut the fuck up

Because we cannot have nice things, everyone has to receive meaningless cold calls or scam calls every day. No matter if you are a worker who has to pay attention to every phone call, or a person who fears the sound of the phone ringing, you definitely HATE these spam calls, they waste your energy and time. So yea this is a post venting about it.

item.title: The person I have forgetten
item.description:
Somewhat unnerving experience I had

I have met many people in my life, and I usually remember someway or the other. While I may be face blind, I can vaguely remember their features in my head. Sometimes I will forget what they look like, but I would at least remember their actions, their words, and how much I can trust them. There is one person whose face I have forgotten, nor her identity, but the fact I forgotten so much about her makes me feel eerie.

item.title: Mecca Chameleon
item.description:
I suck at hide and seek

If you browse social media enough, surely you have seen a game called Mecca Chameleon, a game of hide and seek. If you used to frequent in Minecraft servers like me, the similar example is the hide and seek games where you hide as a block and camoflage within the envirnoment. Seeing this game made me feel both nostalgic and curious, as this game takes a whole new level: You have to paint your own body, as an artist myself I might have an advantage at this!
